name: ImportSettings
doc: Declarative importer configuration, stored as the single i_settings record.

fields.name: preset
fields.doc: Texture encoding quality override. Omit this field to inherit the project preset in ara.imports; Balanced is the default for new projects.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Exact importer version, including encoder implementation versions.

fields.name: dependencies
fields.doc: Referenced authoring assets, using project-relative @path#id syntax.
